study_archetype: animal experimental study assessing autonomic function in disease model

reported_items.raw_name: Objective: assess sympathetic over-activity and proarrhythmic risk in collagen-induced arthritis (CIA) rats
Study design: experimental animal study with collagen-induced arthritis model in Lewis rats and control group
Data/sample: 9 CIA rats and 9 control rats (Lewis rats) with arthritis induced by intradermal type II collagen emulsion

Primary methods: single-lead ECG recorded 30 min every two days; HRV analysis including time- and frequency-domain parameters, LF/HF ratio, detrended fluctuation analysis (DFA), deceleration capacity (DC), and acceleration capacity (AC)
Main outcome measures: differences in HRV parameters (including LF/HF) between CIA and control rats over time
Primary results (summary): LF/HF ratio significantly higher in CIA rats during first and second week versus controls (values and p<0.05 reported)
